resources.title: (NEW) The PERFECT BLOOPRINT Rust Base Design 2025 (Compound/Bunker/TCs)
resources.creator: Mellarrkk
resources.noteEs: Tutorial paso a paso del compound base design de Blooprint, replicado por Mellarrkk con annotation de TCs, bunkers y honeycomb. 40 minutos densos — pausa frecuente recomendada para construir junto al video.
resources.noteEn: Step-by-step tutorial of Blooprint's compound base design, rebuilt by Mellarrkk with TC, bunker, and honeycomb annotation. 40 dense minutes — frequent pausing recommended to build along.

resources.title: THE PERFECT 2025 BUNKER BASE - Rust Base Design
resources.creator: shots
resources.noteEs: Diseño de bunker optimizado para 2025 con soft sides protegidos, loot rooms anidados y peek angles defensivos. 22 minutos con voiceover claro y vista isométrica que ayuda a entender el layout.
resources.noteEn: Bunker design optimized for 2025 with protected soft sides, nested loot rooms, and defensive peek angles. 22 minutes with clear voiceover and isometric view that helps understand the layout.

resources.title: Rust Power Distribution And Logic Flow | Rust Electricity Guide | 2025
resources.creator: PlaguePhreak
resources.noteEs: Guía de electricidad enfocada en distribución y logic flow — no solo el wiring básico, sino cómo planear el power budget de la base entera, branches lógicos y backup de battery. Complemento perfecto a Rustrician.
resources.noteEn: Electricity guide focused on distribution and logic flow — not just basic wiring, but how to plan the whole base's power budget, logical branches, and battery backup. Perfect complement to Rustrician.

resources.title: We Built the greatest Canyon fortress in Vanilla Rust..
resources.creator: Willjum
resources.noteEs: Wipe completo construyendo una fortaleza compound en zona de canyon. Combina narrative y design decisions — útil para ver cómo un clan organizado piensa layout, ubicación y defenses cuando tiene tiempo de planear.
resources.noteEn: Full wipe building a compound fortress in canyon terrain. Combines narrative and design decisions — useful to see how an organized clan thinks about layout, location, and defenses when they have planning time.

resources.title: I Rebuilt My FIRST RUST BASE 10 Years Later and this is how it went
resources.creator: Welyn
resources.noteEs: Welyn revisita un diseño suyo de 2015 y muestra qué cambió en 10 años: mecánicas de stability, honeycomb actual, electricity. Útil como historia editorial del game-meta de base building a través del tiempo.
resources.noteEn: Welyn revisits a 2015 base design of his and shows what's changed in 10 years: stability mechanics, modern honeycomb, electricity. Useful as an editorial history of base-building meta through time.
